title.ja: 塩漬けの肉と、金貨三枚の値札
title.en: Salted Meat and the Three-Gold-Coin Tag

quote.ja: あたしが本物だと言い張って売るものは、全部まがい物だ。それなのに、買った奴らが勝手にそれを本物にしてしまう。
quote.en: Every single thing I sell as "authentic" is a sham. And yet, the people who buy them somehow turn them into the real deal on their own.

mood.ja: 偽物が引き起こす奇跡に気味の悪さを覚えながら、売りたくない首飾りの値段をまた吊り上げている。
mood.en: Feeling creeped out by the miracles my fakes perform, while once again hiking up the price of a necklace I secretly dread to sell.
